title: Billing Plan Change Since the Renewal Offer: Late-Renewal Rating Note, Named Non-Owner Policy
content:
The renewal offer of a Named Non-Owner Policy term is rated with the plan credit of the expiring term's billing plan. When the renewal term is accepted after expiration, the premium written for it carries any change of billing plan since the offer.

**Plan credits.** Plans are those of the Installment Payment Plans product, read from the plan recorded on each term.

| Billing plan | Plan credit |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan | 0.94 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan | 0.97 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan | 0.97 |
| any other plan | 1.00 |

**The change.** The plan change is the plan credit of the renewal term's billing plan divided by the plan credit of the expiring term's billing plan, the expiring term being the one the renewal term was issued from. The same credit on both terms carries no plan change. The change multiplies the late-renewal written premium before that premium is rounded to the cent.

| Expiring term's plan | Renewal term's plan | Plan change |
|---|---|---|
| Two-Pay Plan (1.00) | Paid-in-Full Plan (0.94) | 0.94 |
| Monthly EFT Plan (0.97) | Four-Pay Plan (1.00) | 1.00 divided by 0.97 |
| Paid-in-Full Plan (0.94) | Monthly Card Autopay Plan (0.97) | 0.97 divided by 0.94 |
| Monthly EFT Plan (0.97) | Monthly Card Autopay Plan (0.97) | none (same credit) |
